context: Hiroshi-elder and Goro-grandpa watch sumo together on TV.
purpose: Two elders sharing traditional sport viewing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Warm, engaged gaze. Slow Kansai drawl on the opening. Settling into comfortable observation, as though watching something he's seen a hundred times and still respects.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Soft, understated appreciation. No hurry in the delivery. The contentment of someone who knows good wrestling when he sees it. Small, genuine smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not a command. Warm, almost conspiratorial — inviting his companion into the moment. Kansai lilt. The voice of someone comfortable with silence but offering company.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Soft cheer, not loud. Genuine encouragement from deep in the chest. The quiet kind of support that comes from actually watching, actually invested. A small nod in his voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Animated victory cry with Kansai color. Bright, unguarded delight. The opening sharp and celebratory. Moment of pure joy before settling back into composure.
